comment: Very old fashion, lecture heavy class. Repeats himself often and talks very slowly which is not for me personally. Will cold call. One of the most boring classes I've ever taken. Not the worst but I would recommend looking for someone else if you can. Exams are 25% but he will drop a grade (terms and conditions apply). $200 textbook required.

One main reason being, you never know your final grade. Their grading system scales off 3 tests, many pop quizzes, homeworks, and chapter works. Additionally, they have mentioned that your canvas grade isn't your final grade. Meaning you'll never know your final grade until the end of the semester

This class is very lecture heavy but if you listen well and take good notes you will be fine. He has a policy where he drops the lowest 25% of your grade between 2 midterms, class assignments, and homeworks which saves a lot of stress. Overall Prof. Arafat is a very thoughtful professor and you can tell he really cares about his student's success.

Dr. Arafat is a lovely professor and is extremely accessible outside of class. His class is very lecture heavy; however, it is a good way to test yourself on the content if you did the readings before class. There is a reading due most classes, a pop quiz following the readings, and a class work and mindtap assignment. It is all easy if you do it.
Take this class for the way he grades; it's easier to get a good grade when he drops your lowest 25%. Definitely a boring class, but I learned a lot for never taking econ before.

His class was very lecture-based, which could be long at times. He assigns the same amount of homework as other teachers, but grades it harsher than they do. The class was not terrible, and I learned a lot, but his syllabus was often inaccurate, and homework was ambiguously assigned, with him only mentioning it once at the end of class.

Great Professor, definitely lecture heavy which worked well for me, I think his lectures are engaging and helpful, and if you pay attention you will easily do well in the class. There are a lot of class-works, mindtap assignments, and pop quizzes but he is very accessible to help.

Arafat is a great teacher and takes his time to explain difficult concepts. There are readings every week, and "pop quizzes" after each assigned reading. 
Class is weighted out of 125% so your lowest exam will be dropped at the end of the semester. It can be boring at times, but you will learn a lot, and its very manageable to do well in his class.

You learn through lectures.  Long, boring, sometimes unclear lectures.  Dr. Arafat assigns busywork to complete out of class and grades you on it.  Long, repetitive assignment on MindTap which are easy to slip up on and lose points which hurt your grade.  He gives pop quizzes and classwork assignments which usually spill out of class and are long.
